added_failures_source: unmeasured: the reviewed run's manifest names no baseline_suite or after_suite gate logs (both fields empty), so no base/head pair was compared; the count is recorded as unmeasured rather than zero

findings.text: follow-on: the record is a forward-solve terminal-state evidence document but carries no poloidal flux contour panel of the terminal state, which the repository plotting rule requires of every GS forward-solve evidence record; docs/figures/forward-solve-api/ holds no outboard/census figure and the fragment contains no img or figure element, so the ten changed supports whose booking moved 1,477,703.687599 A are never drawn and the reader cannot see the geometry the re-pin claim rests on.

follow-on: the receipt's machine-readable recommendation is 'repair' in all five committed receipts (bookings-isolated, bookings-all, census-candidate-cells, census-merge-direct, triangle-reference) while the evidence document recommends re-pin; the ternary emits 're-pin' only when one run carried both booking and reference, and every committed receipt was run with a single --component, so current_matches_reference and reference_a are null throughout and a coordinator reading the JSON verdict gets the opposite of the prose.

follow-on: error_bound = 0.0 is a literal, so the receipt field quadrature_error_bound_a records a measured-looking zero for a bound that was never computed; the real convergence evidence is the per-level relative_change ladder in quadrature_cells (a reader can and did confirm agreement at 4.9e-9 to 1.4e-7 relative), but the zero field is the unmeasured-recorded-as-zero pattern and should either carry a computed bound or be null.

follow-on: the plan item f-fsapi-outboard-census-exact-total asks to first establish when the committed state was written and in which clip mode its solve actually ran, and its done-when requires the test to pass against that state with no tolerance widened; this record establishes neither the state's write time nor its solve clip mode, and the gate test is untouched and still red, so the re-pin rests on the route-change explanation alone and the plan half remains open (declared a follow-on, not a silent omission).

justifications.durability: no committed test imports benchmarks/outboard_census_exact_total.py (grep over tests/ returns nothing), so _archive_tree, _measure, _triangle_reference and the archive-isolation logic are exercised only by runs in /tmp and by the run-dir receipts; a regression that reused one arm's module across revisions (the defect the rejected bookings-all receipt shows) would pass the repository green, and the gate that would catch the booking is out of scope and currently red.
justifications.evidence: every headline reproduces independently from the committed receipts: exact totals 14,013,835.437176 A at 247e5aa4a and 15,491,539.124774866 A at 38b441dad/main; the ten changed cells are exactly 5,7,30,65,74,78,87,110,119,124; their after-sum is 1,477,703.6875989058 A against the triangle reference 1,477,703.686366 A, an 8.3403e-10 relative agreement over a before-sum of 6.146e-10 A; and the archive-isolation correction is verifiable because bookings-all.json shows every arm resolving 247e5aa4a's census module while bookings-isolated.json gives each arm its own path. The evidence fragment at line 57 also cites the cause correctly against the commit diff.
justifications.fit: the benchmark follows the benchmarks/ idiom of argparse components and typed helpers, its names carry no plan or version label, and the integration is stated as a mechanism (sampled_boundary = count > _WHOLE_CELL_VERTEX_CAPACITY) rather than an author or ticket; it loses points because the evidence record omits the required poloidal flux contour panel and the receipt advises 'repair' against the document's re-pin, and because error_bound is hardcoded rather than measured.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the substantive question the plan poses -- whether the committed state or the current booking is wrong -- is answered by measurement: the chord total is invariant at 15,875,439.764504 A, the exact total moves 1,477,703.687599 A at 38b441dad, and an independent triangle reference over the ten changed supports reproduces that move to 8.34e-10 relative, so the current booking is right and the pin is stale; the cause is named by file and line (clip_quadrature.py 516-521 and 731-736, the sampled_boundary routing, separate from the custom_jvp at line 851). It is not full credit because the plan's done-when also requires the test to pass against a state whose write time and clip mode are recorded and verified, and this node records neither and leaves the re-pin to a follow-on, so the item remains open.
justifications.scope_discipline: all twelve commits a7d6e0e39 through 4177f36ee touch only benchmarks/outboard_census_exact_total.py (eleven commits) and docs/evidence/fragments/forward-solve-api/fsri-outboard-census-exact-total.html (4177f36ee), both inside the declared write paths, with nothing under nova/ or the plan; every commit carries a conventional subject and a body; no plan, sprint, ticket or version label appears in a path, symbol or comment.
